title: Mars Is More Mapped Than Our Own Seafloor
hook: We know Mars better than our own ocean floor.
closing: Earth: the only planet we haven't finished mapping.
question: Ocean floor or Mars first?

segments.say: By 2026, a decade-long global project has mapped just 28.7 percent of the ocean floor in real detail.
Compare that to Mars, sitting at 99.5 percent mapped -- we know a foreign planet better than our own seafloor.
That unmapped ocean slice alone covers about 257 million square kilometers, bigger than the entire surface of Mars.
